description: Remove a source from a project's register for good, with its authors — it cannot be undone, so do it only when the person asked for this very one to be deleted; confirm its key with them first. Its journal keeps its lines and one that it was deleted. A source found to be wrong is not deleted: set_source 'check' 'mismatch' with the reason keeps it said. Members of the project who may write only.

id.description: The source, as list_sources returned it.

source.description: Its key or an identifier it has, with 'project'.

name: delete_source
title: Delete source
